scenario: Arithmetic operators work at runtime per LEXP.3.2. A rule gated on `a.v + b.v > 100` fires only when the sum exceeds 100.
rules_ds:
schema A scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    v: Int mutable

schema B scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    v: Int mutable

schema Sum scope logical:
    dummy: Int key

rule big_sum:
    A a
    B b where a.v + b.v > 100
->
    emit Sum logical dummy: 0
